text: Helm panel opens with 'Hold station at 9.997 rs' while ALTITUDE NOW reads 10.000 rs and the slider thumb is pinned at the far right; the target and the readout disagree before the player touches anything. The 3D view behind the panel is a cramped close-up of the helm desk, so the window/black hole is mostly hidden.

At 1.18 rs the helm panel shows a REAR CAMERA 'looking away from Erebus' and the caption says every star is squeezed into this patch, but the image looks like a black-hole shadow with a bright lensed ring spanning the whole frame, not a small patch of sky with darkness around it. Hard to tell what I am looking at; the caption and image do not obviously match. Panel also gains a vertical scrollbar.

Objective 'Hold for 20 seconds' shows no countdown or progress anywhere (objective box, helm panel). With the game running at ~6-8 ticks/s, 20 game seconds took over a minute of real time and there was no sign it was progressing.
Pressed Esc at the helm console (as the panel hint 'Esc or Q to step back' says) and nothing happened; the slider just got a focus ring. Panel stayed open.

Ines says 'Okay. That's enough. Take us back up.' (tick ~4500, ~2000 ticks after the hold began) but the objective box still reads 'Hold for 20 seconds' and objective 2 never completes; the 20 game seconds elapsed at tick ~3650. Player gets contradictory instructions.

Probe console, 'Launch Orpheus' button: clicked it 4 times plus a mouse-hold over ~45 s real time (ticks 5875-6251); nothing happens, no feedback, no objective shown. WREN had just said Orpheus is loaded at the probe console.
After launching Orpheus the in-world PROBE screen still reads 'ORPHEUS ready'. The Orpheus marker reads '1+z 1.01 . its clock 2.7 M' - unexplained jargon ('1+z', 'M') for a player.

Orpheus feed ends on frame 65 sent from 1.211 rs ('signal weak', heavy noise, shadow filling the frame), status 'Next frame due: never'. Feed itself renders well and the slowing frame cadence reads clearly. But after 'never' appears (tick ~11100) the objective 'Watch the Orpheus feed' stays incomplete and nobody comments for 1000+ ticks; it is unclear whether I am done. Also the in-world screen to the left of the panel is cut off by the panel and drawn at a skewed angle.
End of Orpheus: 'What do you tell Ines?' choice box straddles the 3D view and the console panel, covering the feed caption and the frame-counter text. Fine to read, but overlaps the panel.
